panel.loadFailedChats: We couldn't check for existing chats, so a new chat won't start.
panel.loadFailedMessages: Sending is paused because this view may not match the actual chat.
panel.placeholder: Ask about projects or notes with @
panel.overlap: “{note}” is already in “{project}”. Keep only the meeting note?
panel.awaitingApproval: You can't send while an approval is pending.
panel.refetchFailedChats: Couldn't reload the chat list. Your answer is still on screen.
panel.refetchFailedMessages: Couldn't reload the chat history. Your answer is still on screen.

composer.scopeLimit: You can add up to {max} items.

picker.label: Projects and meeting notes to add
picker.hint: ↑↓ to move · Enter to select · Esc to close · Keep typing to filter

thread.disconnected: The connection was lost. Refresh to see the answer saved so far.

thought.stalled: This is taking longer than usual. Keep waiting or stop.
thought.notes: {count, plural, one {# meeting note} other {# meeting notes}}
thought.refs: {count, plural, one {# meeting note referenced} other {# meeting notes referenced}}
thought.moreRefs: {count, plural, one {Show # more meeting note} other {Show # more meeting notes}}

reasons.blind: It's unclear what this would do, so it can't be approved. Decline it.
reasons.ended: The chat ended before this approval was handled.
reasons.unknown: The approval was sent, but the chat ended before the result came back.
reasons.notFound: This approval was already handled or is no longer active.
reasons.chatNotFound: The chat couldn't be found, so this can't be handled.
reasons.notOwner: Only the person who asked can handle this approval.

approval.submittedHint: This is confirmed once the response resumes.
approval.waitingHint: Waiting for you to approve or decline. To cancel, press Stop.

turnFailures.TURN_TIMEOUT: The response took too long and stopped.
turnFailures.UPSTREAM_ERROR: Couldn't generate a response. Try again in a moment.
turnFailures.APPROVAL_EXPIRED: Stopped after waiting too long for approval.
turnFailures.CAPACITY_EXCEEDED: We're getting a lot of requests right now. Try again in a moment.
turnFailures.SERVICE_RESTARTING: The response stopped because the server restarted. Send your message again.
